about: Data of the test suite (tools/test.sh). A fixed bug report becomes a line here, so nothing breaks twice. Poses: level frame x east, z = -north (m); heading clockwise from north (rad), forward = (sin h, -cos h). Positions come from the level files where they have them (spots.json, bridges.json, sbahn.json, roofs_deck.json, level.json); only what no file holds is written here.

static.bench_reason: accepted wall-contact differences of the new car model adopted on 2026-11-21 (the car slides along a wall instead of sticking to it; no built-in sideways creep when pressed against a wall). tools/vehicle_ref.json and VEHICLE_INTERFACE.md 6.8 describe the previous model. Not a bug.

spots.why: every spot link starts the car where it can drive off (stuck-at-start reports, 2026-11-20/21)
spots.expect_note: per-spot exceptions: {"<slug>": {"min_m": 0, "why": "..."}} for a spot that faces an object on purpose

bridges.why: 2026-11-21: the car stopped 2-3 m short of the museum-side heads (rails from the closed-water test); after the fix it drives ~12.5 m through every head. Heads = first / last point of `line` in bridges.json. The broken data is kept as levels/mitte_all/bridges.json.pre-heads.

sbahn.why: each station door (sbahn.json entrances, `approach` pose) puts the car on the tracks (door on the wrong building, 2026-11-21)

roof.why: a fall from the roof ends back on the roof at the route's start (js/roofs.js FALL_TO = 'start', owner 2026-11-21), roof mode on

coast.why: releasing all keys at 50 km/h stops the car in ~2.8 s / 19 m (owner-accepted, VEHICLE_INTERFACE.md); start = level.json spawn (a straight street)

map_drive.why: map driving (hidden): N opens the map paused, W starts driving on it, closing the map leaves the car where it is
